entities.name: Agents
entities.rationale: Independent agents accessing the insurance application, represented by the user group icon on the left.

entities.name: CloudFront
entities.rationale: Distributes the single-page application and routes traffic, labeled as CLOUDFRONT.

entities.name: S3
entities.rationale: Hosts the single-page application static assets, labeled as S3.

entities.name: API Gateway
entities.rationale: Entry point for backend API calls, labeled as API GATEWAY.

entities.name: Lambda Authorizer
entities.rationale: Validates incoming API requests, labeled as AUTHORIZER LAMBDA.

entities.name: Lambda
entities.rationale: Core serverless Python stack executing modernized business logic, labeled as LAMBDA.

entities.name: EC2
entities.rationale: Hosts the legacy Tomcat application containing unmigrated functionality, labeled as EC2.

entities.name: DynamoDB
entities.rationale: Stores and caches regional user information across availability zones, labeled as DYNAMODB.

visual_connections.description: Agents send web traffic and API calls to CloudFront.
CloudFront fetches the single-page application from S3.
CloudFront routes backend API requests to API Gateway.
API Gateway invokes the Lambda Authorizer to validate access.
API Gateway routes validated calls to the core backend Lambda function.
Lambda calls the legacy application running on EC2 for unmigrated functionality.
Lambda reads and writes cached user session data in DynamoDB.
